title: Government & e-Governance
tagline: Citizen services, national ID, and government portals
description: Official government digital services and e-governance portals. Most are form-based or require login; documented public APIs are rare. We list the canonical URLs plus a few well-known community scrapers where they responsibly fill a real gap.

resources.name: Nagarik App
resources.description: Government super-app for citizen services: NID, citizenship, license, passport status, PAN, traffic e-chalan, voter pre-registration. Built by NITC. ~1.5M+ users; 2022 World Summit Award winner.

resources.name: Citizen Portal — DONIDCR
resources.description: Department of National ID and Civil Registration. National ID smart card application and status — 17.2M+ enrolled by mid-2025. Backend by IDEMIA.
resources.note: [Automated] Link appears to be broken or unreachable.

resources.name: DONIDCR Official Site
resources.description: Department of National ID and Civil Registration — main portal.

resources.name: Department of Drug Administration (DAMS)
resources.description: Authoritative drug registry public-info portal. Form-based search.
resources.note: [Automated] Link appears to be broken or unreachable.

resources.name: NEA Online Billing
resources.description: Nepal Electricity Authority online bill viewing/payment.

resources.name: NEA Bill Checker (Community)
resources.description: Open-source NEA bill calculator/checker by community contributor.

resources.name: Inland Revenue Department
resources.description: VAT, PAN, taxpayer registration. See also the dedicated IRD CBMS API in the Government APIs category.

resources.name: IRD Taxpayer Portal
resources.description: Self-service portal for VAT/PAN return filing, tax payments.

resources.name: Department of Transport Management
resources.description: Driver license, vehicle registration, BlueBook services. Digital BlueBook integrated with Nagarik App (Bagmati province only as of 2025).

resources.name: DOTM Driver License Application
resources.description: Online driver license application portal.

resources.name: Election Commission Nepal
resources.description: Election Commission — voter pre-registration, e-bulletins, results.
resources.note: [Automated] Link appears to be broken or unreachable.

resources.name: ECN Voter Data Scraper
resources.description: Scrapes ECN PDFs for 7 provinces, 77 districts, 753 municipalities, 6,743 wards, 10,756 polling stations. Educational/research use only.
resources.note: Respect ECN terms; don't scrape personal voter data.

resources.name: Department of Passport — eMRTDS
resources.description: e-passport pre-enrollment portal. ~4.53M e-passports issued by April 2025.
resources.note: [Automated] Link appears to be broken or unreachable.

resources.name: Department of Foreign Employment — FEIMS
resources.description: Labor permit system; ~7.6M+ permits since 2008. ⚠️ The site dofenepal.com is NOT the official portal.

resources.name: Office of Company Registrar — CAMIS
resources.description: Company registration, annual filings, search.
resources.note: [Automated] Link appears to be broken or unreachable.

resources.name: OCR Open Government Data
resources.description: Bulk CSV/XML downloads of company registrations 2002–2072 BS. One of the more substantive open-data offerings from a Nepali ministry.
resources.note: [Automated] Link appears to be broken or unreachable.

resources.name: Hello Sarkar
resources.description: 24/7 multi-channel grievance portal (call 1111). Operated by OPMCM.
resources.note: [Automated] Link appears to be broken or unreachable.

resources.description: Government services directory — entry point for ministries and departments.

resources.description: Government data center; runs Nagarik App and the GIWMS CMS used by many .gov.np sites.
